panels.description: Shows the current status and configuration of all segments in the cluster, including segment roles, preferred roles, synchronization mode, status, and network details
panels.title: WHPG Segment Configuration (Live)

panels.description: Lists the tables with the highest proportion of dead rows, showing live and dead row counts along with dead_row_percentage. Tables with high dead row percentages are considered “bloated” and may require vacuuming to reclaim space and improve performance.
panels.title: Top 20 Bloated Tables

panels.description: Shows the 20 tables consuming the most disk space in the database. This helps identify tables that are the biggest contributors to storage usage, useful for capacity planning and monitoring growth trends.
panels.title: Top 20 Largest Tables by Disk Usage

panels.description:
Lists the tables that have never been vacuumed or auto-vacuumed and currently contain dead rows.
These tables are at high risk of bloat, increased I/O, and degraded query performance.
This list can be used to prioritize manual VACUUM operations or adjust autovacuum settings to ensure timely cleanup.
panels.title: Top 20 Tables Not Vacuumed

panels.description:
Displays the tables containing the highest number of dead rows across the database.
Dead rows accumulate due to updates and deletes and contribute to table bloat, increasing storage usage and degrading query performance.
This list helps identify tables that may require VACUUM, ANALYZE, or maintenance tuning.
panels.title: Top 20 Tables With the Most Dead Rows

panels.description:
Identifies tables where sequential scans are performed more significantly than index scans, suggesting missing or inefficient indexes.
These tables meet the following conditions:
	•	seq_scan > 100 — frequently scanned sequentially
	•	idx_scan < seq_scan — index usage is low compared to seq scans
	•	A high seq_to_idx_ratio indicates potential optimization opportunities

If no such tables are found, a placeholder row is returned.

This view helps detect tables that may benefit from new indexes to improve query performance
panels.title: Tables Likely Needing Indexes

panels.description:
Shows tables that are missing ANALYZE statistics, based on the number of columns without collected stats.
Tables lacking proper statistics can cause the query optimizer to choose suboptimal execution plans, leading to slower performance.
This list helps identify tables that should be analyzed to ensure accurate row estimates and efficient query execution.
panels.title: Top 20 Tables Missing Statistics

panels.description: Shows the top 20 queries generating workfile spills in the cluster.  If no active spill queries exist, a placeholder row is shown to indicate zero spill activity.
panels.title: Top Queries by Spill Usage

panels.description: Displays the total number of workfile spill files and total spill size (in bytes) for each segment in the cluster.
panels.title: Spill File Usage per Segment

panels.description: This panel shows the percentage of time the disk spent doing write operations averagedover the last 5 minutes.
panels.title: Disk Write Utilization (%)

panels.description: This panel shows the percentage of time the disk spent doing read operations averaged over the last 5 minutes.
panels.title: Disk Read Utilization (%)

panels.description: This panel shows total number of filesystem or device errors across all monitored disks and partitions for each server

panels.description: Shows the percentage of CPU currently in use per instance, calculated as 100 - %idle over the last 15 minutes. This provides a 15-minute rolling average of CPU utilization across the system.

panels.description: Shows the percentage of CPU actively used on each host, calculated as 100 - %idle over the last 5 minutes.
panels.title: CPU Utilisation for every Host (Current)

panels.description: The average number of processes that are in the run queue over a specific time period using 1 min rolling average
